definitions.explanation: Being released from a hospital after treatment.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}{退院|たいいん}できます。
examples.english: I can be discharged next week.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{無事|ぶじ}に{退院|たいいん}しました。
examples.english: My father was safely discharged from the hospital.

examples.japanese: {退院|たいいん}おめでとうございます。

notes:
{退院|たいいん} means leaving/discharge from hospital.

RELATED TERMS:
- {入院|にゅういん}: hospitalization (opposite)
- {通院|つういん}: visiting hospital as outpatient
- {病院|びょういん}: hospital

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {退院|たいいん}する: to be discharged
- {退院|たいいん}{後|ご}: after discharge
- {退院|たいいん}{日|び}: discharge date
